IronWorks Fitness -- Personal Training Policy, Section 7

7.1 PT sessions are sold in packs of 10, valid 6 months from purchase; unused sessions
expire with no refund after 6 months.
7.2 Cancelling a scheduled session with 24+ hours' notice: the session is not deducted.
7.3 Cancelling with less than 24 hours' notice, or a no-show: the session is deducted as
if it happened, UNLESS it is the client's first-ever late-cancel/no-show on the account,
which is forgiven once as a courtesy.
7.4 If the TRAINER cancels a session, the client's original session is preserved (not
deducted) AND a bonus session is added to their pack at no charge.
7.5 Packs cannot be shared between family members or transferred to anyone else under any
circumstance.

Client file -- Bianca Torres, 10-session pack purchased March 1, 2026. She has attended 6
sessions as scheduled. She cancelled one session with 3 hours' notice -- her first-ever
late cancellation on the account. Separately, her trainer cancelled a different scheduled
session due to illness.

questions.instruction: Under this policy, is Bianca's 3-hours'-notice cancellation deducted from her pack?
questions.notes: Less than 24 hours' notice would normally deduct the session (7.3), but this is her first-ever late cancellation, forgiven once as a courtesy.

questions.instruction: How many sessions remain in Bianca's pack after these events?
questions.notes: 10 - 6 attended = 4; the forgiven late-cancel and the trainer-cancelled session are not deducted (still 4); the trainer cancellation adds 1 bonus session -> 5.

questions.instruction: Under this policy, can Bianca let her sister use two of her remaining sessions?
questions.notes: 7.5 prohibits sharing or transferring packs between family members or anyone else under any circumstance.

Brightwater Graduate School -- Thesis Submission Policy, Section 11

11.1 Master's thesis drafts are due to the committee no later than 45 days before the
scheduled defense date.
11.2 A one-time 14-day extension may be granted if BOTH: (a) the student's advisor
submits a written extension request, AND (b) the request is submitted before the original
45-day deadline passes. Requests submitted after the deadline has passed are ineligible
regardless of reason.
11.3 A second extension beyond the first may be granted only for a documented medical
emergency verified by the Dean of Students' office, capped at an additional 30 days.
11.4 If no draft is submitted by the (possibly extended) deadline, the defense is
automatically cancelled and rescheduled for the following semester at the earliest.

Case file -- Yusuf Demir, defense scheduled June 15, 2026 (draft deadline: May 1, 2026).
His advisor submitted a written extension request on April 25, 2026, which was granted,
moving the deadline to May 15, 2026. By May 15, Yusuf still hadn't finished and requested
a second extension citing exam stress and a heavy TA workload -- not a medical emergency,
and not verified by the Dean of Students' office.

questions.instruction: Under this policy, is Yusuf entitled to a second extension based on exam stress and workload?
questions.notes: 11.3 requires a documented medical emergency verified by the Dean of Students; exam stress and workload don't qualify regardless of the advisor's or student's wishes.

questions.instruction: What was Yusuf's draft deadline after the first extension was granted?
questions.notes: May 1 + the 14-day extension = May 15, 2026; June 15 is the (unrelated) defense date, a distractor.

questions.instruction: Under this policy, would the first extension have been valid if the advisor's request had been submitted on May 3, 2026 instead?
questions.notes: 11.2(b) requires the request before the original deadline (May 1); May 3 is after it, so the extension would not be eligible.

questions.instruction: Which of the following are true about Yusuf's situation?

candidates.description: The advisor's request was submitted before the original deadline
If he misses the May 15 deadline, his defense will be automatically cancelled

questions.notes: The first extension and its timely request are both true, and 11.4 makes automatic cancellation the live consequence of missing May 15; no second extension, no documented emergency.

hold," blocking course registration but NOT transcript requests.

blocking BOTH registration and transcript requests.

questions.instruction: Under this policy, is Grace blocked from requesting her transcript?
questions.notes: 22.3: alumni have transcripts withheld for any unpaid balance with no minimum threshold -- her $8 is enough, unlike the $20 threshold for a current student.

candidates.description: Within 2 business days of confirmed payment

questions.notes: 22.4: holds release within 2 business days of confirmed payment, not immediately upon submission.

candidates.description: Beth is blocked from registering for courses

The same dollar threshold applies to both Beth and Grace

14.1 Wholesale listings require a minimum order quantity (MOQ); orders below MOQ are

14.2 Price Match: if a buyer finds an identical wholesale listing (same seller, same SKU)
at a lower price within 7 days of purchase, the seller must refund the difference upon
request, UNLESS the lower price was part of a flash sale lasting under 24 hours (flash

14.3 Wholesale orders cannot be cancelled by the buyer once the seller has marked them "in

questions.instruction: Under this policy, can Quentin cancel his order now that it's marked 'in production'?

City of Rivendale -- Home Occupation Permit Code, Section 25

25.1 A Home Occupation Permit is required for any business operated from a residential
property that involves client/customer visits, on-site employees other than residents, or
exterior signage.
25.2 Exempt from permit: purely online/remote businesses with NO client visits, NO
non-resident employees, and NO exterior signage.
25.3 Home Occupation Permits are capped at 2 client visits per day and 1 non-resident
employee, EXCEPT for licensed home childcare (a separate track, Section 26), which may
have up to 6 children present and is not bound by this cap.
25.4 Businesses generating parking demand for more than 2 non-resident vehicles at a time
are not eligible for a Home Occupation Permit regardless of other factors and must seek a
commercial zoning variance instead.

Case file -- Talia Reyes runs a small bookkeeping practice from home, seeing clients by
appointment (typically 1-2 per day), no employees, no exterior signage, and never more
than 1 client vehicle parked at a time.

questions.instruction: Under this policy, is Talia's business exempt from needing a Home Occupation Permit?
questions.notes: 25.2's exemption requires NO client visits at all; Talia sees 1-2 clients/day, so she needs a permit despite having no employees or signage.

questions.instruction: Under this policy, does Talia need a commercial zoning variance instead of a Home Occupation Permit?
questions.notes: 25.4's variance requirement is for demand exceeding 2 non-resident vehicles at a time; she never exceeds 1, so a standard permit suffices.

questions.instruction: Which of the following would let a home business exceed the standard 2-visits/1-employee cap without a zoning variance?

candidates.description: Being a licensed home childcare provider

questions.notes: 25.3 carves out licensed home childcare as a separate track exempt from the standard visits/employee cap.

questions.instruction: Which of the following are true about Talia's business under this policy?

candidates.description: Is operating as licensed home childcare

questions.notes: She needs a permit (client visits trigger 25.1); she stays within the visit and vehicle caps, isn't exempt (has client visits), and isn't a childcare business.

HomeComfort Furniture Warranty, Section 5

5.1 Individual furniture pieces carry a 2-year structural warranty (frame, joints)
covering manufacturing defects.
5.2 Fabric/upholstery is separately warranted for 1 year against manufacturing defects
only (not stains, sun fading, or normal wear).
5.3 "Matching set" purchases get a combined warranty: if one piece requires a frame
replacement under warranty and the identical replacement frame is no longer manufactured,
the customer may return the ENTIRE set for a full refund instead of a mismatched repair,

honored at the store manager's discretion but are not guaranteed under this policy.

model has been discontinued and is no longer manufactured. They have their original
receipt.

A refund for the entire matching set

questions.instruction: Which of the following are true about the Ferraros' warranty situation?

They can choose a full refund for the entire set
Their claim is about fabric, not the frame

VoyageGuard Travel Insurance Certificate, Section 14 (Rental Car Damage)

14.1 The Rental Car Damage benefit (a paid add-on, $6/day) reimburses the deductible a
traveler owes under the RENTAL COMPANY's own damage waiver, up to $1,500, if the traveler
purchased the rental company's basic (deductible-bearing) waiver.

questions.instruction: Under this policy, is Desmond's $750 deductible reimbursed by the Rental Car Damage benefit?

Desmond purchased the rental company's basic waiver

skiing off marked trails, bungee jumping) are excluded from medical/trip-interruption
benefits UNLESS the traveler purchased the Adventure Sports Rider ($25 flat per trip).

questions.instruction: Under this policy, is Tobias's zip-lining injury covered even without the Adventure Sports Rider?
questions.notes: 16.3: zip-lining isn't on the high-risk activity list, so it's covered under standard benefits with no rider needed, unlike Nia's deep dive.

questions.instruction: If Nia had been diving without required certification when the incident occurred, how would her claim be treated?

candidates.description: Fully covered because of the Rider
Covered only up to half the cost
